text:
nico_l: quick alert: perf watchdog flagged memory growth after hotpatch `alloc-hotfix-2026-08` landed in a tiny edge-slice. seeing fragmentation + p95 drift on long requests.

anya_k: which slice and fraction?

nico_l: us-east-longtail, 0.2% traffic, started 03:05. bundle id alloc-hotfix-2026-08.

deploybot: rollout metadata: rolled to 0.2% at 03:02; feature flags: tiled-matmul=on, alloc-reclaim=aggressive.

anya_k: benchmarks were short; long-tail could expose free-list fragmentation. ops, can we run a focused smoke with seq 8k/16k?

opsbot: queued: `ops smoke --bundle alloc-hotfix-2026-08 --nodes=3 --seqlens=8192,16384 --dur=300 --collect=mem,p95,ooms` ETA 6m.

opsbot: smoke complete: 8k p95 +10% mem +4% no OOM; 16k p95 +53% mem +40% 1 OOM on host us-e-11. logs: https://internal.run/smoke/3222222222

nico_l: reproduces on 16k. recommend pause and pin back to `alloc-stable-2026-07`. TTL 4h to let infra investigate.

deploybot: suggested action: `pin-version --target=us-east-longtail --version=alloc-stable-2026-07 --ttl=4h`

anya_k: agree. also open a debug PR to disable aggressive reclaim and add early-kv-free; run long-tail harness (30m) before re-roll.

release-coordinator: i'll draft a short internal note and a release-notes internal line: "Temporarily paused a limited long-tail slice after observing memory growth with alloc-hotfix-2026-08; reverted to previous stable while team prepares a targeted patch." will not publish externally yet.

nico_l: pinning now.

deploybot: executed: pin applied. routing reverted. TTL 4h. monitoring will alert if p95 > baseline *1.25 for 10m or OOMs >0.

opsbot: subscribed. will run extended verification on debug build when PR lands.

anya_k: i'll open the patch PR and tag for priority review. include perf snapshots, flame graphs, and a deterministic reproducer.

release-coordinator: thanks. leaving thread open until debug build passes long-tail CI or TTL expires. closing for now.
